extension.summary: A green-phosphor radar scope showing the aircraft flying over you right now
extension.description: The Vintage Radar scope in a window you can drive: the same phosphor disc, range rings, compass rose and sweeping beam as the screensaver, with a nearest-first contact list and a spotlight card. Click a contact or a list row (or press Select) for its full card: callsign, registration, type, category, hex, squawk, altitude and geometric altitude, ground speed, track, magnetic and true heading, IAS, TAS, Mach, vertical rates, navigation settings, position, distance, bearing, signal quality, message counts, service flags and whether the fix came from ADS-B, MLAT or TIS-B. Left and Right step through the contacts, Page Up and Page Down turn the list, Menu opens the settings and Back leaves the scope. Aircraft come live from adsb.lol with OpenSky as a fallback, centred on your chosen place and range; the companion screensaver, Vintage Radar (OpenGL), puts the same scope on your idle TV.
extension.disclaimer: Aircraft data comes from the volunteer-run adsb.lol and OpenSky Network APIs and is used as-is; it is not for navigation or flight safety. The Doto typeface (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is baked into texture atlases under resources/media/fonts.
